title: Kissed Peppery American Portobello Mushroom Bake
description: A nostalgic American dish featuring peppery portobello mushrooms baked in a wood-fired oven with bay leaves, wrapped in ti leaves for a plant-based friendly meal. This recipe combines the earthy flavor of mushrooms with a hint of pepper and the aroma of bay leaves.

ingredients.name: portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stems removed and caps sliced 1/2 inch thick

instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the mushroom slices.
Place a bay leaf on each mushroom slice, then wrap each slice in a ti leaf.
Place the wrapped mushrooms in the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Flip the mushrooms and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes, or until they are tender and the ti leaves are crispy.
Remove the mushrooms from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the mushrooms hot, garnished with additional bay leaves if desired.
